Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](../persons.html#939) am home again and at work, having greatly enjoyed my holiday.
I hope to see you soon in London.

Will you kindly give us notice when you are coming. I am anxious to see what can be done, if anything in the way of a [vignette](../others.html#167) for the “[Dove](../books.html#62)”.

Yours ever truly
A.

Macmillan
Many thanks for the information you kindly sent [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
